However, the app uses config ldap pointing to planetexpress, which won't match the test_users ldif (example.org). Let me look at the cypress support and the app's actual config. But the local config is commented out, so web.config.php is used: ldap host 'ldap' which doesn't resolve (only openldap resolves).

Hmm, but maybe the app has its own LdapUtility. Let me check the cypress support to see what username/password it uses.
